reason: A sidebar Q&A plugin for selecting conversation text, asking follow-up questions in an embedded panel, and organizing independent nested follow-up sessions with configurable context handling.

summaries.zh: 在侧边栏中对选中的对话文本发起问答，支持上下文摘要、独立追问会话、嵌套追问和追问记录管理。
summaries.en: Ask questions about selected conversation text in a sidebar with context summarization, independent follow-up sessions, nested questions, and follow-up history management.

capabilities: Captures user-selected conversation text for follow-up questions
Displays embedded streaming Q&A in a sidebar panel
Summarizes conversation context and generates follow-up session titles through configured language models
Creates independent workspace sessions and supports nested follow-ups
Provides configurable model, context, and reasoning settings
